t: This is Justice, a sculpture by Tanya Russell. She's a British sculptor who works in bronze, and her work mostly depicts animals, so it's worth looking closely at the figure and the way it's modelled. Russell is a member of the Royal Society of Sculptors. I don't have more detail about this particular piece, so take your time with it. Notice the surface of the bronze, the pose, and how the work holds its place here.
